title: AgentVoice event socket
description: Protocol 2 fleet NDJSON event contract: lifecycle/voice events and typed conversation observation, live snapshots, bounded replay and scoped native history pages. Lifecycle and conversation snapshots have separate watermarks; voice events are never replayed. See docs/events.md and docs/conversations.md.
